description: Sanctions and export-control screening for people, companies, vessels and crypto addresses: fuzzy name match (aliases, transliterations) or exact wallet / contract lookup against the lists Prax pulls continuously: US OFAC (SDN and Consolidated), UK OFSI, EU, UN and Swiss SECO, every crypto address they list on any chain, plus the US Consolidated Screening List (BIS Entity List, Denied Persons, Unverified and Military End User lists, State nonproliferation and ITAR debarred parties, OFAC sectoral, FSE, CAPTA, menu-based and Chinese military-industrial lists). Returns match / possible_match / no_match with hits (entity, type, programs, list, authority, aliases, addresses, licence requirement, Federal Register notice, score). Use for KYC / KYB onboarding, payment screening and trade compliance. Free plan.
